translations.name: Greater Kansas City Coalition to End Homelessness (GKCCEH) - Coordinated Entry
translations.description: Coordinated Entry is the front door to housing programs for people experiencing homelessness in the Kansas City area. A trained assessor at a partner agency completes one standard assessment and connects you to housing and support services on both sides of the state line.
translations.warning: This is not emergency shelter. Housing openings are limited, so there may be a wait after your assessment. If you need a place to stay tonight, call 211.
translations.website_description: Get assessed for housing programs if you are experiencing homelessness in the Kansas City area.
